logline: 소를 팔러 간 소년이 콩 몇 알을 얻어 오고, 그 콩이 하룻밤 새 구름까지 자란다.
destination: 구름 위 거인의 성 — 줄기를 끝까지 오른 자리
protagonist: 헝클어진 금발에 기운 조끼를 걸친 열두 살 소년
setting: 옛 잉글랜드의 가난한 농가와 구름 위의 성
anchor: a twelve-year-old English boy with tousled fair hair, patched waistcoat and rolled trousers
palette: meadow green, cloud white, cottage brown, cold sky blue, warm amber

jack.label: 소년
jack.desc: a twelve-year-old English boy, tousled fair hair, patched waistcoat, rolled trousers, bare feet

mother.label: 어머니
mother.desc: a worn Englishwoman in her forties, hair under a linen cap, patched apron over a grey dress

cottage.label: 오두막 마당
cottage.desc: a small thatched cottage with a bare kitchen garden, low stone wall, wooden gate

giant_hall.label: 거인의 성
giant_hall.desc: an enormous stone hall with a table and chair many times human size, cloud beyond the window

beats.beat: 소년이 콩 몇 알을 어머니에게 내민다.
beats.visual: a boy holding out a few beans on his palm to a worn woman before a thatched cottage
beats.motion: his palm opens toward her, her hand strikes it aside, the beans scatter and bounce

beats.visual: an enormous green beanstalk risen through a cottage garden at dawn, dwarfing the roof
beats.motion: the stalk sways upward into the cloud, leaves unfurl, dew shakes off the coils

beats.visual: a boy climbing a vast beanstalk high above patchwork fields, cloud close overhead
beats.motion: he pulls himself upward along the stalk, leaves bend under him, wind tears past

beats.visual: a small boy stepping over the threshold of a stone hall built many times his size
beats.motion: he walks forward into the hall, dust lifts around his feet, the doorway looms

beats.visual: a golden egg rolling off the edge of an enormous wooden table onto a stone floor
beats.motion: the egg rolls off the table and drops, it strikes the stone and spins away

beats.visual: an enormous stone hall with dust shivering off the beams, a doorway dark beyond
beats.motion: dust shakes down from the beams, the floor trembles, the far doorway darkens

beats.visual: a boy sliding down a vast beanstalk toward distant fields, something clutched to his chest
beats.motion: he slides downward fast along the stalk, leaves whip past, wind drags at him

beats.visual: a huge severed beanstalk stump in a cottage garden, coils of vine collapsed around it
beats.motion: the cut vine settles across the garden, leaves drift down, dust lifts and clears

withheld: 거인이 소년을 쫓아 내려오는 대목과, 줄기를 벤 뒤에 벌어지는 일
